title: A not-yet bill settled by a line dated before the setup day: the line comes after the opening, whatever its date (decision AB4; confirm_review_2 item 4, d2)
story: Set up Tue 22 Jun 2027 at 09:00. The bank holds 200,000, of which 30,000 is what is left of Free to spend (typed). The phone bill of 8,000 was due Mon 21 Jun and has not gone out yet; a side job's 500.00 dollars was due Tue 22 Jun into the yen bank and has not come in. Setup asks about each; both are saved in `not_yet`. A second bank, Savings, holds 50,000; its water bill of 5,000 was due Sun 20 Jun and had not gone out at setup either. On Thu 24 Jun at 20:00 the person reads the bank's statement: the phone bill's line carries only the bill's own date, Mon 21 Jun (the statement gives no posted date). The same evening they type the water bill as paid from Savings, dated its due day, Sun 20 Jun, naming the bill. Pay of 250,000 on the 25th (moved earlier) starts the period; rent of 80,000 on the 27th (moved later). Before AB4 each line counted as inside the opening by its date, so the bank stayed at 200,000. Every amount is made up.
